Priya Nair: Handing off CogniaHealth POC -> CS. POC start 2025-04-14, hosted API (chat + embeddings). Pilot: ~90k tokens/week, ~8k embeddings, 2 routes (clinical-notes, search). SSO (Okta) in progress; customer classifies data as PHI and expects Private/VPC before renewal. Renewal ~8 months, tagging ~60% risk if compliance or latency not addressed.

Priya Nair: Sales asks: predictable latency (<300ms p50 for summaries), KMS/audit logs, and pricing cap for nightly embedding batches. SF opp: https://salesforce.company/opp/Cognia-77

Priya Nair: Quick handoff items:
- CS owner: Mira Patel
- Support ticket: SUP-4999 (Ethan Cole)
- Eng owner: Ravi Shah (model routing & infra)
- Artifacts: sample long prompt set + embedding CSV in SF

Mira Patel: Taking lead. I'll schedule kickoff + create onboarding doc for integration steps, eval prompts, cost sensitivity, and renewal watch items. Who will enable telemetry?

Priya Nair: Contacts: anita@cogniahealth.com (Head of Data Eng), luke@cogniahealth.com (DevOps). They agreed to enable a 48hr read-only telemetry window after kickoff.

Ethan Cole: Created SUP-4999 stub. Will request telemetry export, example prompts, and peak-hour list. Assigning initial triage ETA 48h after telemetry access.

Ravi Shah: I'll bench M-Gen-7B vs M-Gen-13B for long-context summarization with KV cache ON/OFF and batch sizes 1,4,8. Also preparing Private/VPC feasibility checklist (KMS, audit logs, network whitelist). Will post results by 2025-04-16.

OnboardBot: Reminder: onboarding checklist assigned to Mira Patel, due in 7 business days.

Mira Patel: Calendar invite sent for 2025-04-14 09:30 PT. Creating shared doc for feedback capture and prompt-set evals. Will add survey to capture integration pain and confirm owners for enablement items. :thumbsup:

Priya Nair: Noted. I added billing owner contact in SF and flagged renewal risk (60%). If latency + KMS path are confirmed this can flip to expansion. Leaving handoff to CS & Support.

Ethan Cole: Will link SUP-4999 to the shared CS doc once telemetry is uploaded and post next steps.

Mira Patel: Added owners and initial action items in the doc. Will post a short recap in this thread after kickoff.
